title: POINTCAST COLLEGE FOOTBALL — Issue 001 / Talkin' Season
dek: One living magazine for the belief board, receipt book, Song Yard, mascot desk, future stadiums, Saturday Commons, and season ledger
body:
The ranking is one department. The season is the magazine. PointCast College Football gathers 25 FOR REASONS, the public Receipt Book, The Song Yard, the Saturday Myth Machine, Saturday Rebranded, Saturday Commons, and the append-only Season Ledger under one masthead. Each desk keeps its own method while contributing to one issue people can revisit through the season.

Issue 001 opens The Song Yard beyond the current PointCast 25. West Virginia, UCLA, Michigan State, Arizona State, Colorado, Kansas, Rutgers, Syracuse, Wisconsin, and Virginia Tech join as selectable Open Field programs, giving the practice room thirty-five unofficial place-derived identities.

The Repertoire Desk begins with sixteen researched program dossiers and forty-eight song references. Every track receives one of three evidence labels. Stadium ritual means a reliable source documents repeated game-day use. Documented performance means a band or program used the song without PointCast claiming permanence. PointCast candidate means a regional or structural proposal worth testing, not an adopted tradition.

Reference links open public reporting or a licensed Spotify search. PointCast does not host recordings, reproduce lyrics, reconstruct protected melodies, proxy streaming audio, or present an editorial candidate as institutional fact. The original six-seed, four-part Song Yard practice system remains sample-free and gesture-gated.

The magazine is unofficial editorial work. It is not affiliated with, commissioned by, or endorsed by any school, conference, stadium, band, artist, label, publisher, or governing body.
